title: Bones
description:
S02 E18 — The Killer in the Concrete
Booth suspects an organized-crime family when a partial skeleton is found encased in concrete, and he tries to lure the suspected killer out of hiding; Brennan gets a surprise visit from her father (Ryan O'Neal) while visiting her mother's grave.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E19 — Spaceman in a Crater
When Brennan and Booth investigate a body that was found in a crater, evidence suggests that it had been in outer space.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E20 — The Glowing Bones in the Old Stone House
Potentially radioactive remains emit a green glow at the crime scene.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E21 — Stargazer in a Puddle
Brennan and Booth investigate a small skeleton assumed to be that of a 10-year-old girl; Brennan's father (Ryan O'Neal) reappears in her life to deliver information from her past.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E01 — The Widow's Son in the Windshield
A skull smashes the windshield of a car driven by a group of teenagers on the freeway; a trail of suspects leads Brennan and Booth to a strange cannibalistic society; Cam suggests that Angela hire a private investigator to find her ex-husband.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E02 — The Soccer Mom in the Mini-Van
Brennan and Booth investigate when a soccer mom is blown up in her minivan; the investigation uncovers that the woman was a member of the National Liberation Army.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E03 — Death in the Saddle
The team investigates a footless corpse that was found in the woods; Brennan and Booth's questioning leads to several suspects, including the victim's wife; Angela agrees to undergo hypnosis to remember her former husband's name.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E04 — The Secret in the Soil
When the founder of an organic supermarket chain is found dead, Brennan and Booth suspect foul play by a rival farmer; the two agents visit a new psychiatrist, who warns that the FBI may separate them.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E05 — Mummy in the Maze
When mummified remains are found at Halloween attractions, Brennan and Booth realize that they must find the killer by Halloween or there will be another death.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E06 — Intern in the Incinerator
The team suspects colleagues when the remains of a young Jeffersonian intern are found in the building's incinerator; Booth poses as Cam's boyfriend and accompanies her on a family get-together.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E07 — Boy in the Time Capsule
When high-school classmates reunite to unearth a time capsule buried 20 years earlier, they find the corpse of an adolescent friend inside; while combing through the victim's life, the team members rehash their own teen years.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E08 — The Knight on the Grid
After construction workers find an archbishop's body with the kneecaps surgically removed, the team returns to the case of the Widow's Son serial killer.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E09 — The Santa in the Slush
Three days before Christmas the body of a bearded man in a tailor-made Santa outfit turns up in a sewer; Brennan visits her father in prison and plots a nontraditional holiday reunion.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E01 — Exposed
A local FBI case involving two murdered women and a sea of powerful men turns into a manhunt for the dangerous leader of a far-reaching criminal enterprise.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E02 — The Panamanian Monkey Job
With a new team member on board, plus the arrival of Hardison's genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E03 — The Rollin' on the River Job
The Leverage team takes on a greedy riverboat casino owner, before he can bulldoze the homes of longtime New Orleans natives for his planned expansion.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E04 — The Tower Job
One member of the team seeks redemption and justice by convincing Leverage to con a developer out of an entire luxury apartment building.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E13 — Nelson's Sparrow
The members of the BAU team are brought back to their origins as they look at one of Gideon and Rossi's old cases.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E14 — Hero Worship
When a hero emerges from the wreckage of an explosion in Indianapolis, the BAU team members must protect him as they try to identify the person responsible before more bombings occur.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E15 — Scream
The members of the BAU team search for a suspect who may have witnessed abuse as a child; Kate is worried when her niece and a friend make plans with a boy they met online.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E16 — Lockdown
When two guards at a maximum security prison are murdered, the BAU team thinks one or more people within the prison walls may be responsible.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E17 — Breath Play
The BAU tracks a serial killer in Wisconsin; Kate is faced with trouble when her niece, Meg, starts acting out.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E18 — Rock Creek Park
When an up-and-coming congressman's wife disappears, the team investigates his political enemies as potential suspects.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E19 — Beyond Borders
International Unit Chief Jack Garrett (Gary Sinise) and his team requires assistance from the BAU when a family of four is abducted during their Barbados vacation.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E20 — A Place at the Table
When the members of a family are found murdered at their dining room table, the team looks for secrets in their past; Hotch tries to make peace with his father-in-law (Ed Asner).

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E21 — Mr. Scratch
When three alleged murderers claim that they were attacked by a monster at the moment of the crimes, the BAU searches for a suspect who controls minds; the hunt puts one team member in danger.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E22 — Protection
The BAU tracks a vigilante in Los Angeles who is shooting people with possible ties to criminal activity.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E23 — The Hunt
The team suspects Kate's niece and her friend were kidnapped by an online predator involved in sex trafficking and race to find them before they are hurt.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S11 E01 — The Job
The BAU interviews candidates to take the opening left by Kate's departure; the team tracks a serial killer who leaves behind evidence that indicates a person intent on revenge.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S11 E02 — The Witness
The team must find the person responsible for a sarin gas attack on a Los Angeles bus before a larger incident occurs.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S11 E03 — 'Til Death Do Us Part
The team suspects a jilted unknown subject is responsible when brides are murdered on the eve of their nuptials.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E06 — Devil's Night
The team searches for a killer who has struck the past three years during Detroit's raucous pre-Halloween celebrations.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E05 — The Good Earth
When four men from Oregon go missing, the team looks for a common link; J.J. is upset when her son doesn't want to celebrate Halloween.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S09 E06 — In the Blood
Ritualistic murders lead the team to believe their suspect may have a fascination with the Salem witch trials; Garcia plans a Day of the Dead celebration.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S10 E05 — Boxed In
A child reappears one year after he went missing -- but the team must work quickly when a trick-or-treater disappears under similar circumstances.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E05 — The Tall Man
The BAU investigates a spooky local ghost story of the "Tall Man" and the clues it provides when two people go missing in the woods; a third person mysteriously surfaces the following day with limited details as to what happened to her friends.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E14 — Sick and Evil
The BAU investigates a string of murders taking place in supposedly haunted houses in Lewiston, Maine.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E03 — Tough Love
When a judge known for serving harsh sentences to juveniles is murdered, the team looks into his lengthy list of cases in the hunt for his killer; Kristin faces family hurdles while resettling with her teenage daughter in New York City.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E01 — Improvise
Three months after quitting the Phoenix Foundation and moving to Nigeria, Mac puts aside his differences with his father and returns when he hears Jack is the target of a murderous dictator he double-crossed.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E02 — Bravo Lead + Loyalty + Friendship
Jack receives an emergency distress signal from one of his old Delta buddies who has been accused of terrorism in a foreign country; MacGyver and Jack quickly recruit the rest of Jack's old Delta team and stage an unsanctioned rescue operation.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E03 — Bozer + Booze + Back to School
MacGyver and the team go undercover on a college campus to find an operative who is recruiting students to carry out deadly attacks; Jack joins bounty hunter Billy Colton in the hunt for a bail jumper.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S02 E13 — Toxic
The team tracks two brothers who are set on getting revenge against members of the company that caused their town's environmental destruction; Sarah meets the rest of the LaCroix family, including Jess' sister.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S02 E14 — Hustler
The team heads to Washington, D.C., to protect Ortiz's former informant after a hit man tries to kill her; Sarah helps Jess' family prepare for Byron and Marie's last-minute wedding on Jess' farm.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S02 E15 — Chattaboogie
Jubal enlists the help of Jess and his team in tracking down an undercover DEA agent who appears to have turned dirty; Sarah wonders if it was a mistake to move in with Jess and Tali so soon.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E01 — Exposed
A local FBI case involving two murdered women and a sea of powerful men turns into a manhunt for the dangerous leader of a far-reaching criminal enterprise.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E03 — Tough Love
When a judge known for serving harsh sentences to juveniles is murdered, the team looks into his lengthy list of cases in the hunt for his killer; Kristin faces family hurdles while resettling with her teenage daughter in New York City.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E16 — The Strike in the Chord
The team investigates the death of an a cappella singer whose body was found in a lab rat; Hodgins applies for an experimental nerve regeneration study; Booth tries to plan a summer trip with Parker; a new intern joins the lab.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E17 — The Secret in the Service
An intoxicated college student discovers the dead body of a Secret Service agent just before a scheduled presidential visit to the area; former intern Dr. Colin Fisher leads the investigation while Brennan battles a case of the flu.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E18 — The Movie in the Making
A documentary crew producing a television segment on the Jeffersonian's Medico-Legal lab follows the team as it investigates a corpse found in a landfill.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E19 — The Head in the Abutment
Booth's hockey knowledge comes in handy when the team investigates the death of a player whose headless corpse was left in the river; Hodgins and Oliver use drones to see who can retrieve the victim's head.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E20 — The Stiff in the Cliff
The investigation into the murder of a billionaire explorer who went missing 10 years earlier reveals Dr. Clark Edison as a suspect; Cam's sister visits to help with wedding plans.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E21 — The Jewel in the Crown
A diamond is found in the jaw of a corpse discovered at a glass recycling plant; Booth learns that he has a medical issue; Hodgins thinks a ghost is following him.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E22 — The Nightmare in the Nightmare
The team attempts to find The Puppeteer, a serial killer from the past, who lives with his victim's bodies before disposing of them; Brennan struggles with guilt over not stopping the killer earlier.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E01 — The Final Chapter: The Hope in the Horror
Booth and the lab team desperately search for Brennan after she's kidnapped by her former assistant, Zack Addy.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E02 — The Final Chapter: The Brain in the Bot
The team investigates whether an artificial intelligence bot was programmed to kill its creator; Bones plans a surprise for her birthday.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E03 — The Final Chapter: The New Tricks in the Old Dogs
The team becomes enmeshed in retirement home drama when the body of an old man is found in an acid dump site; back at the lab, discussion of marriage and kids dominates the conversation.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E04 — The Final Chapter: The Price for the Past
The team investigates the death of a person from Booth and Brennan's past; Aubrey learns his dad is back in the picture.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E05 — The Final Chapter: The Tutor in the Tussle
When a tutor who works with privileged students turns up dead, the team sifts through possible murderers; Bones wants to voice her own audiobook.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E06 — The Final Chapter: The Flaw in the Saw
The investigation into the murder of a golfer-turned-lumberjack reveals numerous secrets that could have led to the victim's demise, including an affair with a married rival.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E07 — The Final Chapter: The Scare in the Score
Corpses that are linked to Booth's former Army unit turn up around D.C.; Brennan's father hides a serious medical procedure from her.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E08 — The Final Chapter: The Grief and the Girl
A recent loss creates tension between Booth and Brennan as they each try to deal with their grief; an old flame from Brennan's past visits.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E02 — No. 1 Fan
An erratic whistleblower who calls Pride her mentor kidnaps him to help her locate a serial killer targeting young women in the Gulf of Mexico.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E03 — The Asset
The team joins forces with FBI Director Isler after a Russian operative with intelligence on sleeper agents disappears; Tammy partners with former sleeper agent Eva Azarova to assist in the disappearance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E04 — Dead Man Calling
The team investigates the copycat murder of an unsolved case from 150 years ago that spawned a legendary ghost story; Gregorio is spooked when the case is connected to a recent séance and a local medium.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E05 — Viral
Sebastian is placed on administrative leave after being questioned by the FBI about a foot chase; Pride and the team attempt to clear Sebastian's name.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E07 — The Accident
The team investigates after a clinical trial in which brain implants are put into veterans is hacked; Patton must work alongside his ex-wife, who spearheads the project.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E08 — Sins of the Father
Wade's son asks Pride for help after being attacked and discovering his girlfriend is missing; Pride must meet with a therapist to discuss his process for solving cases.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E09 — Hard Knock Life
Pride starts to doubt evidence suggesting homeless kids murdered a petty officer.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E10 — Mirror, Mirror
Rita Devereaux tells Pride that Douglas Hamilton is about to make a deal to get out of prison; Pride and the team re-investigate the Clearwater case in hopes of spoiling his plans.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E22 — I'Ike Ke Ao
The team races to save an abducted college student from a dangerous vigilante; Max, Kamekona and Flippa struggle to survive after being shipwrecked.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E23 — Pilina Koko
The Five-0 team learns that one of its own has a deep connection to the young daughter of a woman who was murdered in her home.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E24 — Pa'a Ka 'Ipuka i Ka 'Upena Nananana
Five-0 tries to protect a wounded Gabriel and plan an escape when enemy gunmen storm the dilapidated building in which Gabriel is trapped.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E25 — O Ke Ali'I Wale No Ka'u Makemake
McGarrett and Danny pose as drug pilots in a plan to stop a meth epidemic on the island; Danny is forced to break cover and land the plane when McGarrett is seriously wounded.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E01 — Makaukau 'oe e Pa'ani?
The team hunts for a murderer who has been targeting serial killers, marking their corpses with an ivory chess piece.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E02 — No Ke Ali'i Wahine A Me Ka Aina
A rogue MI-6 agent is the key to finding a terrorist who plans to cause the meltdown of nuclear reactors across Europe; McGarrett and Danny need the help of an FBI profiler to find a killer.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E03 — He Moho Hou
After finding a corpse in her bed, FBI profiler Alicia Brown joins McGarrett in a hunt for a killer; Kono reconnects with a former surfing competitor.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E04 — Hu A'e Ke Ahi Lanakila A Kamaile
When the serial killer that Alicia and McGarrett have been hunting kidnaps them, it's up to Five-0 to find them before it's too late.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E05 — Ke Ku 'Ana
A cache of guns is stolen by a person looking to make a statement on gun violence; Kono and Adam are reunited.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E06 — Ka Hale Ho' Okauweli
On Halloween, the team investigates the murder of a medium who was apparently frightened to death by a poltergeist; a mysterious death cult kidnaps Kono and Adam.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E07 — Ka Makuahine A Me Ke Keikikane
Catherine informs Five-0 that McGarrett's mother has been captured and is in danger of being executed for trying to free Wo Fat's imprisoned father; Chin is unable to delay Sara's adoption.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E08 — Hana Komo Pae
While Danny chaperones Grace's high school dance, the venue is seized by terrorists, who hold everyone hostage with the intent of abducting a diplomat's son; Danny and Grover discover that Will is Grace's secret boyfriend.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E09 — Elua La Ma Nowemapa
A conspiracy theorist with compelling information that JFK's own cabinet planned his assassination is murdered.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E10 — Ka Luhi
A boy suffering from PTSD undergoes hypnosis and realizes he may have witnessed a murder related to a 10-year-old cold case; Danny's sister visits Oahu.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E11 — Ka'ili Aku
The team rushes to Mexico, where Chin puts his life in jeopardy in an effort to rescue Sara, his kidnapped niece.
